integration_point_for_new_feature.why: To capture 'this' pointer for stepSequencer_ access

evidence_summary: PatternPreviewDialog returns Result struct with patterns vector (category, displayName, pattern steps) via async callback. Current workflow saves to UserPatternDatabase. SampleBrowserPage has stepSequencer_ pointer and can inject patterns using FlexiblePatternSet or addTrackRow(DrumTrack). Conversion from PatternEntry to DrumTrack is straightforward. The callback lambda needs 'this' capture to access stepSequencer_.
